about_the_game:
With the 90 Days of Premium Pack, you’ll get:
  • 90 days of WoT Premium account
  • 10 Large Repair Kit
  • 10 Large First Aid Kit
  • 10 Automatic Fire Extinguisher

Enhance your in-game experience with 3 months of WoT Premium account! Take advantage of the ×3 XP bonus modifiers for first wins in any vehicle, bonus credits, extra excluded map slot, and more! Plus, the bonus consumables in the 90 Days of Premium Pack add even more value, giving you the tools you need to survive tough battles.

DLC can be added to your World of Tanks account only once.
Items will be credited to the first account you log in to the game with.
